title: Qt: Properly name testCaptureFileClose
description:
In essence this method tries (!) to close the app by checking first
if there is an active capture and that needs to be closed. Only if
that is the case, the closing will succeed and the method will return
true to signal to whomever that they can continue closing the app

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: changed title from Qt: Fix resizing issues with sidebar cards to Qt: Properly name testCaptureFileClose
Closing and reopened at https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24229 due to merging issues
